_README: dt-lockcheck findings judged not to be defects.  Maintained with --confirm-false-positive, not by hand; see tools/dt-lockcheck/README.md.

entries.reason: _update_histogram() runs on the pipe but never calls GTK: it takes an atomic g_object_ref() on the widget and hands it to gdk_threads_add_idle(), so the GTK call itself happens on the main thread.  This is the correct idiom for reaching a widget from the pipe, not a defect.

Ownership passes through the call_auto_levels state machine rather than through the lock, and the handovers are locked even though the accesses are not: the pipe touches g->params only after taking state 0/1 -> -1 under gui_lock, and _develop_ui_pipe_finished_callback only after taking 2 -> -1 under the same lock.  Exactly one thread owns the field at a time, and the locked transitions carry the memory ordering.
